title: 油布下的补给
text: 断墙下压着一捆军团的油布，木牌上还刻着领用人的姓名。外层缠着可以回收的绳布，里面是防潮包好的食物。要保住内层的包装，得慢慢拆开。

texts.en: A bundle of Legion oilcloth is pinned under a broken wall, a wooden tag still carved with the name of whoever signed for it. The outer wrapping is rope and cloth worth saving; inside, food packed against the damp. Keeping the inner wrapping whole means opening it slowly.

options.label: 拆开内层（倒计时 −{pass_time_actions}，食物补给 ×1）

outcomes.text: 你剥去受潮的外层，取出了{reward_name}。四周的滴水声没有停过。

texts.en: You peel away the damp outer layer and take out the {reward_name}. The dripping around you never stops.

labels.en: Salvage the outer wrapping (rope or cloth ×1)

outcomes.text: 你收起还能使用的{reward_name}，留下没有拆开的内包。

texts.en: You keep the {reward_name} that's still usable and leave the inner pack unopened.

outcomes.text: 你把刻有姓名的木牌翻回正面，继续赶路。

texts.en: You turn the name tag face up again and move on.
